stories.title: I'm angry my Jehovah's Witness mum died - she didn't want to 'disobey God'
stories.summary: Estera Pawlek's mother Ela refused potentially life-saving surgery due to her religious beliefs.

stories.title: Property firm told to repay customers thousands over 'unfair' sales tactics
stories.summary: Let Property must make the "unprecedented" number of repayments after complaints were made to a watchdog.

stories.title: Hosting World Cup means decade of excitement - Weir
stories.summary: Scotland captain Caroline Weir says hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup along with England, Northern Ireland and Wales will usher in "an amazing decade of excitement" for the game in her homeland.

stories.title: Former health secretary calls for sackings over NHS Grampian deaths
stories.summary: Alex Neil says the handling of a review which found 19 avoidable deaths at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary "stinks" of a cover-up or extreme incompetence.

stories.title: Man arrested after woman, 22, raped in Glasgow park
stories.summary: Police arrested the 37-year-old man on Monday and say their investigation into the Kelvingrove attack is ongoing.

stories.title: £20,000 reward offered for Glasgow shooting information
stories.summary: Police say they have spoken to more than 100 people since the shooting in Lambhill on Monday 16 November.

stories.title: Historic Dunoon venue facing closure due to soaring running costs
stories.summary: The board of trustees at Dunoon Burgh Hall said the venue will shut on 20 December.

stories.title: Pub chain drops bid to serve children after backlash
stories.summary: Signature Pubs had planned to let teenagers buy food, snacks and soft drinks in three Edinburgh bars.

stories.title: Unison members vote to reject council's new pay structure
stories.summary: Unison said 70% of members who took part in the ballot voted to reject Glasgow City Council's proposals.

stories.title: Cafe manager wins first World Shortbread Championship
stories.summary: Noreen MacKenzie says she was shocked to take top prize at the event in Inverness.

stories.title: Arts charity worker unfairly dismissed while facing cancer
stories.summary: Bryan Peterson has been receiving treatment for an aggressive brain tumour.

stories.title: 'Increasing concern' for missing 20-year-old woman
stories.summary: There is a large police presence around the home of Kelsey Hunter who was last seen in Castle Douglas on Saturday.
